notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 96–227, § 8, Apr. 3, 1980, 94 Stat. 322, which barred legal claims for lands lost through tax or other sales since Sept. 1, 1954, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
